label: Requires new clean power for data centers
description: Whether new data centers should have to bring or pay for new clean or renewable electricity supply.
suggested_question: Should new data centers in this district be required to bring new clean power with them? Why or why not?

label: Protects ratepayers from data center costs
description: Who pays for grid upgrades and electricity costs caused by data centers: the facility or household and business ratepayers.
suggested_question: If a new data center requires grid upgrades, who do you think should pay for them?

label: Water and energy use disclosure
description: Whether data centers should publicly report how much water and energy they use.
suggested_question: Should data centers be required to publicly report their water and energy use?

label: Moratorium (for or against)
description: Statements about pausing or banning new data centers, in either direction.
suggested_question: What is your position on a moratorium on new data centers, and under what conditions?

label: Local approval or community input
description: Whether local governments or residents should have a say before a data center is approved.
suggested_question: What role should local residents and town governments have in approving a data center?
